user.title: Create a heating profile
user.description: A thermostat-like device with a day and a night temperature range for one room. Under Configure it can also drive an air conditioner to keep that range.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Changes the day/night temperature ranges and start times of a heating profile.

day_temperature.name: Day minimum
day_temperature.description: Lowest temperature during the day; heating aims for it.

day_temperature_high.name: Day maximum
day_temperature_high.description: Highest temperature during the day; cooling aims for it.

night_temperature.name: Night minimum
night_temperature.description: Lowest temperature during the night; heating aims for it.

night_temperature_high.name: Night maximum
night_temperature_high.description: Highest temperature during the night; cooling aims for it.

init.title: Climate control: sources
init.description: Choose a room temperature sensor and an air conditioner to let this profile drive the AC. Leave both empty to use the profile only as a store of values.

data_description.room_sensor: The control decides only on this sensor (averaged).
data_description.ac_entity: Climate entity of the AC that gets the commands.
data_description.power_sensor: Shows whether the AC is working and how hard. Used to leave a mode when the AC idles, and for learning. This or the compressor sensor is required.
data_description.compressor_sensor: On while the compressor runs. Used instead of the power sensor if that isn't set.
data_description.use_forecast: Hourly forecast from Open-Meteo for the Home Assistant location. Lets the control wait for free warmth or cooling, and leave a mode early when it gets really warm or cool outside.

settings.title: Climate control: settings
settings.description: The control picks heat, cool or neutral (fan) and only sets the AC's setpoint; the AC modulates by itself. All values can be changed later.

ac_modes.name: AC modes
ac_modes.description: What the AC is set to.

data_description.active_fan_mode: Fan mode in heat and cool mode.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: What the room is held at.

data.look_ahead: Look ahead to the next period

data_description.target_margin: Heat mode holds the minimum plus this, cool mode the maximum minus this.
data_description.start_margin: Neutral switches to heat mode at the minimum plus this (cool mode at the maximum minus this).
data_description.hard_margin: This far beyond the minimum or maximum the mode switches right away, ignoring waiting, gaps and lockout.
data_description.look_ahead: This long before a day/night switch the next period's range already applies (pre-heats/-cools, skips what the old range no longer needs). 0 turns it off.

mode_changes.name: Mode changes
mode_changes.description: How often heat, cool and neutral may change.

data.idle_exit: Back to neutral after the AC idled for
data.switch_gap: Minimum time between neutral and heat/cool

data_description.min_mode_time: Before the mode can end because the AC idles.
data_description.idle_exit: In heat/cool mode: the AC didn't work for this long and the room is at the target.
data_description.switch_gap: Both ways, except at the hard limit.
data_description.lockout: After heat mode no cool mode starts within this time and the other way round (except at the hard limit).

waiting.name: Waiting for free warmth or cooling
waiting.description: Before heat/cool mode starts. Uses the forecast for the next minutes up to the maximum waiting time.

data.fast_trend: Don't wait when changing this fast
data.warmth_margin: Warmth: outside above the minimum by
data.cool_margin: Cool air: outside below the maximum by

data_description.max_wait: Longest time to wait instead of starting. Also the length of the forecast window.
data_description.fast_trend: No waiting if the room moves this much per 30 min the wrong way.
data_description.warmth_margin: Wait instead of heating if it stays at least this much above the minimum outside the whole time.
data_description.cool_margin: Wait instead of cooling if it stays at least this much below the maximum outside the whole time.
data_description.sun_threshold: Wait instead of heating if the mean global radiation is at least this high.

early_exit.name: Early switch to neutral
early_exit.description: Leave heat/cool mode before the AC idles when it gets really warm or cool outside. Meant to be stricter than the waiting rules.

data.exit_warmth_margin: Warm: outside above the minimum by
data.exit_cool_margin: Cool: outside below the maximum by
data.drift_margin: Room may drift past the limit by

data_description.early_exit: Off: heat/cool mode only ends when the AC idles.
data_description.exit_warmth_margin: Heat mode ends if it stays at least this much above the minimum outside for the whole forecast window...
data_description.exit_cool_margin: Cool mode ends if it stays at least this much below the maximum outside for the whole forecast window.
data_description.exit_window: How far ahead the outside temperature has to stay warm/cool.
data_description.exit_sun: Heat mode also ends if the mean radiation over the window is at least this high.
data_description.drift_margin: After an early switch the room may go this far below the minimum (above the maximum) before the mode starts again.
data_description.drift_time: After this time the normal start point applies again.

learning.name: Learning the setpoint offset
learning.description: The AC gets target + offset (heat) or target - offset (cool). The offset makes up for the AC's own sensor and is learned from the room sensor.

data.learn_settle: Wait after a mode or target change

data_description.auto_tune: Off: the offsets only change when set by hand.
data_description.learn_interval: Minimum time between two changes of an offset.
data_description.learn_gain: Share of the room's error that is corrected per step.
data_description.learn_deadband: Smaller differences between room and target are not learned.
data_description.learn_max_error: Bigger differences are warm-up or free warmth/cooling, not a wrong offset.
data_description.learn_settle: No learning this long after a change.
data_description.learn_average: Time the room temperature is averaged over for learning.
data_description.offset_step: Also limits how fast the setpoint moves.
data_description.active_power: Power at which the AC counts as heating or cooling (not idle).
data_description.high_power: Power at which it counts as warm-up; too cold/warm is then not learned.

manual.name: Manual changes on the AC
manual.description: A change on the AC that the control didn't send pauses the control.

data.command_grace: Ignore changes after own commands for

data_description.command_grace: The AC's reaction to a command of the control is not a manual change.

measurement.name: Measurement
measurement.description: How the room sensor is evaluated.

data_description.average_window: The mode decision uses the room temperature averaged over this time.
data_description.trend_window: Time over which the room's change is measured.

error.control_incomplete: Choose both a room temperature sensor and an air conditioner, or neither.
error.activity_missing: Choose an AC power sensor or a compressor running sensor.
error.offset_range: The smallest offset must be below the largest.
error.power_thresholds: 'AC working hard from' must be above 'AC working from'.
